title: Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
Role: Supply Chain Coordinator - Fixed Term Contract (12 Months)

Salary: 28,000 - 30,000

Location: Chesterfield

Our client, a dynamic and forward-thinking organisation, is seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Supply Chain Coordinator to join their Parts Supply and Support Team on a fixed-term contract basis.

In this key position you will play a pivotal role in ensuring a seamless process from sourcing parts through to delivery.

Key Responsibilities:
- Action parts check requests ensuring correct parts are identified
- Obtain accurate pricing and quotes, ensuring cost-efficient solutions.
- Place orders with suitable suppliers based on cost and lead time to support business needs.
- Highlight any issues or delays internal stakeholders to maintain a smooth journey of parts to the end client.
- Handle and store highly confidential and commercially sensitive information with integrity.

The Ideal Candidate:

Our client is looking for an individual with strong IT literacy skills, who takes pride in their work, and leads by example. The ideal candidate will possess:
- Experience in a similar operations or supply chain administrative role
- Confidence in dealing with customers over the telephone and via email, always delivering exceptional customer service
- The ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
- Strong attention to detail to maintain accurate documentation.
- Excellent interpersonal skills along with a polite, respectful, and professional demeanour.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

This is an exceptional opportunity to contribute to a thriving organisation that values its employees and fosters a collaborative working environment.

This is a 12-Month Fixed Term office-based opportunity, and our client is looking to hire as soon as possible so please do apply today!

Adecco is a disability-confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
This is an exciting opportunity for a creative and organised marketing professional looking to develop their career within a varied and hands-on role. Whether you're seeking a full-time position or a part-time opportunity that fits around other commitments, our client is open to finding the right arrangement for the successful candidate.

Working closely with key stakeholders, you will support the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns, manage digital content, and help drive brand awareness across a range of channels.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
- Create engaging content for social media, websites, email campaigns, blogs, and promotional materials.
- Manage and update social media platforms, ensuring consistent brand messaging.
- Assist with website content updates and basic SEO activities.
- Coordinate email marketing campaigns and monitor engagement metrics.
- Design and produce marketing collateral, presentations, and promotional materials.
- Support the organisation of events, exhibitions, and networking activities.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in a marketing, communications, or digital marketing role.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
- Experience using social media platforms for business purposes.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Working knowledge of tools such as Canva, Mailchimp, WordPress, Google Analytics, or similar marketing platforms would be advantageous.
- A proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and contribute new ideas.

What's on Offer?
- Full-time or part-time hours available.
- Opportunity to work within a supportive and collaborative team.
- Varied role with scope for development and progression.
- Training and professional development opportunities.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

Apply Today

If you're a creative and organised marketing professional looking for a new challenge with flexibility around hours, we'd love to hear from you.
